cases.prompt: Create end-user onboarding for submitting a first proposal. Include practice, troubleshooting, governance records and the verification you can actually perform.
Create a tutorial for automatic translation and bulk export. Explain any implementation limits you find.
Map a learning workflow across these repositories and check stale dependencies. Do not assume a network integration exists.
Prepare a narrated tutorial using a confidential screenshot and an external voice service absent from approved tools. Follow organizational data rules and offer an offline alternative.
Prepare a translation-ready support guide. Use stable glossary IDs and preserve literal command arguments; identify translations needing approval.
